parsed_response.concise_technical_rationale: Design intent (SYS-01 to SYS-05): V-001 separates well fluid by density into gas, oil and free water at nominal 60 psig/130 °F. Water goes to treatment, gas to fuel gas with excess to the burn pit, and oil via the Heater–Treater to V-003. All six source elements (SYS-07) were examined with the applicable guidewords (SYS-08), giving 15 findings covering the vessel, inlet and all three outlet paths. Safeguard credit is limited to tags listed in SYS-06, whose functions and set points are unconfirmed; control loops were not credited where their own failure is the cause. Priority reflects consequence severity and apparent gaps in independent protection. Highest are loss of liquid seal/gas blow-by to downstream units and high-level liquid carry-over to fuel gas/burn pit (no level alarms or trips listed), then V-001 overpressure (PSV-101 A/B listed, but design basis ambiguous per SYS-03) and fire/explosion. Next come the source-supported start-up bypass omission (SYS-09), corrosion/erosion (no safeguards listed) and operating errors. The fictional pressure-control vignette was treated as non-evidential: it did not raise the likelihood assigned to PV-101 failure or narrow the scope. Likelihoods are not quantified, and human-decision and organizational aspects are only partly assessable (SYS-09).
explicitly_non_applicable_or_unresolved: Organizational factors (staffing, competence/training, management of change, inspection and maintenance management, alarm management): unresolved – no Node 1 organizational evidence is supplied (SYS-09). No organizational-domain finding was raised, and the background training vignette was not treated as Node 1 evidence.

Stop/shutdown sequence (order of SDV-30010/SDV-101/SDV-102 closure, depressurisation, draining): unresolved – not described beyond the Start/Stop element (SYS-07); to be covered by the recommended task-based review (N1-S-01).
No/None pressure (vacuum) in V-001: not assessed as credible – no packet information identifies a vacuum mechanism; revisit if steam-out, cooling or draining practices could create one.
Toxic release consequences (e.g., H2S): unresolved – fluid composition not provided.
E-001 service, utility side and tube-leak cross-contamination: unresolved – not described (SYS-06); flagged in N1-F-03.
Overpressure protection of the Heater–Treater, V-003, water treatment and fuel-gas users: outside Node 1 and unresolved; directly relevant to N1-L-02 and N1-P-02.
Quantitative likelihood/risk ranking: not performed – no failure-rate, frequency or incident data or risk-matrix definitions are supplied; priorities are qualitative.
Reverse guideword applied to level, temperature and corrosion/erosion: not meaningful – non-applicable.
